text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear something curious on my way home.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Blip! Blip! Blip!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We've got a bogey! I repeat: we've got a bogey! Team Golshi, deploy immediately!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Roger! Let's go, Trainer! Boo-yah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, she promptly stuffs me into a burlap sack and trundles me off…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We're in the right spot now! No doubt about it! The air is ripe with mystery!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The mystery around Nessie's existence, of course!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Chupacabras, mermaids, kappas—you name an Unidentified Mysterious Animal, and Team Golshi's confirmed it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Our rep as the best cryptid hunters around is on the line! We're not going home tonight till we get Nessie on camera!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now let's get cracking on a plan that'll draw it out in the open!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have no idea what's going on, but I don't have much choice but to play along.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that's literally the boring-est suggestion you could've come up with! I'd rather watch paint dry!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If we wanna see Nessie, we've gotta show it we really mean business! Unless we do air squats the whole time or something, it'll never show its face!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Actually, you know what? You might be onto something! Let our thrilling squat showdown begin! C'mon, it's you and me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Lemme show you what the world's most awesome quads can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ten minutes later…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nrghhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Twenty minutes later…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thirty minutes later…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh, how about that? Apparently, these weeds are edible if you boil them.
choice_data_list: What happened to our squat competition?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What competition? Anyway, let's grab some of this purslane to cultivate at the academy so we can make namul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We secretly plant our harvested purslane in the student council office's flower pot, but get in major hot water when it's discovered…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oooh! I like how you think! No one can resist a neat dance number!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey! ♪ Shimmy on forward! And shimmy on back! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's flashy little dance draws lots of attention…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she finishes, a large crowd has gathered about.

text_block_list.name: Male Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Nice footwork and rhythm! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Female Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Your energy is infectious!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thanks, everyone! Wake up, Tracen Academy dance club! It's time for us underdogs to rise up and take back our thrones!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The spirit of Yamaoka lives in me! Today, we take Japan! Tomorrow, the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although no one has any idea what she's talking about—myself included—the crowd gathered here is moved to tears.
